name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.NoiseHandle.fresh_paths_le_bits
title: Entropy bound: at most N paths can carry simultaneously fresh values in an N-bit ciphertext
statement: Let Y : Omega -> (iota -> X) map each ciphertext (a set Omega of at most 2^N elements, e.g. N-bit strings) to the family of values the decryptor computes on all paths. If every path w in S is locally fresh (for every ciphertext there is another one that changes the value at w and no other path value), then |S| <= N. So in a ciphertext of N bits at most N of the 2^128 paths can carry noise that is information-theoretically fresh given all other paths; for WE_CircuitSAT_Capped (cost, hence ciphertext length, at most 2^100 bits) this is at most 2^100 of the 2^128 paths.
